verdict.rationale: Raygun ships a built-in AI Error Resolution chat, powered by OpenAI or Azure OpenAI, that auto-prompts an LLM with error context and suggests root causes and fixes. Teammates can chat with it together and link conversations into comments. However, the evidence shows only advice for error diagnosis, not an assistant that takes on and carries out tasks, and it needs the user's own OpenAI API key. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can act on tasks (e.g., change statuses, create issues, run workflows), scope beyond error resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Resolve issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy using AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them.
You can chat with this tool collaboratively.
This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
Auto-prompt your chosen LLM with crucial error context from your stack trace, environment, and affected code to get fast and accurate solutions.
Enter your OpenAI API key and select your preferred GPT model (GPT-4 is default).
